text:
Devon: Escalating SageCycle trial — activation blocked. Customer's embed calls are returning 429s and their onboarding flow is stuck at steps 3-5. Support flagged this as a renewal-risk if not resolved in 72h. Ticket: CSUP-12345.

Maria: @Devon thanks — can you paste the specific error payloads and the timeframe? I'll own customer comms and the enablement call.

Devon: Sample from their logs: ```429: rate_limit_exceeded - window=60s - actual=350 reqs/min - at=2026-03-22T15:12:03Z``` They're on Starter and did a bulk import that created bursts.

Zoe: Quick trace shows a client retry loop causing tight bursts. Client snippet looks like: ```while(!done) { callEmbed(); if(err) continue; }``` — no backoff/jitter.

Raj: I can create a temporary exemption on a dedicated pool for them for 24h to stabilize. Need account id + expected QPS.

Devon: Account ID: sagecycle-834. Expected steady QPS ~20, bursts up to ~200 during imports.

Maria: Proposed immediate plan (owners):
- Raj: apply temp exemption / capacity increase
- Zoe: produce quick client patch adding exponential backoff + jitter
- Maria: run enablement call with customer (update + walkthrough)
- Devon: keep ticket and logs synced to the thread
- Amanda: schedule call with customer (confirm preference)

Amanda: Customer prefers 10:00 AM PST tomorrow. I'll hold a slot and share invite once Maria confirms.

Maria: Confirmed — 10:00 AM PST tomorrow works for us. @Devon please attach the support debug bundle and sample logs I can share pre-call.

Devon: Added debug bundle and logs to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CSUP-12345 — includes full request traces and timestamps.

Zoe: We'll ship a client patch to throttle retries with ETA ~3 hours. Will post the patch link here when ready.

Raj: Temporary exemption applied: pool=gpu-dedicated-2, account=sagecycle-834, exemption_until=2026-03-24T16:00:00Z. Monitor closely and rollback if abnormal.

Maria: I'll send an interim update to the customer now: "We identified a client retry pattern causing spikes; we've applied a temporary capacity change and a patch is in progress; we're scheduled for a 10am PST troubleshooting + enablement call tomorrow."

Devon: Customer replied on the ticket: "Appreciate the quick help — we're concerned about renewal if this isn't resolved smoothly."

Maria: We'll add a renewal health flag and plan a 30-day enablement follow-up. I'll also capture customer feedback during the call and propose an enablement session + checklist. Tagging finance/ops for any concession conversation if needed.

Zoe: Patch pushed: https://github.com/redwood/sagecycle-client/commit/abc123 — adds exponential backoff + jitter, and a max-concurrency limiter.

Maria: Thanks everyone — I'll run the 10am PST call, capture action items, and update this thread with the post-call comms and next steps. :thumbsup:
